_comment: EV.2 proof: the simplest possible content verb — one capability, a rename, a schema. This is the shape most content verbs will have.

notes: Shortcut-safe: a pure read of the user's own collection names, nothing to approve and nothing spent. This is also the EV.6 proof that a verb authored entirely in content can reach a Mac App Store user, where no tunnel exists.
